description: Handwritten version 1 waits: an approval wait parked on an event or a wake time with a timeout, a run deadline, an approval TTL and a chat binding; a budget wait woken by its wake time; a question woken by a real answer; a question that timed out unanswered with uncertain release; a redacted question resumed after its uncertain release was reconciled and after a new policy layer; a provider-managed budget wait with a wait limit; an approval woken by a decision a millisecond before its expiry and then ended by its deadline; a question its run deadline ended unwoken, unanswered; an approval resumed under an admitted model and an admitted artifact revision. Every wait pins its execution authority; an approval wait carries its binding and expires. refused fail the schema and both readers; readerRefused hold the rules the schema cannot state and fail both readers.
